dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: Oz, my faithful escort through the darkness! Pave the way for thy Prinzessin with the truth thine eyes behold! All that is lowly escapes my gaze, it is but a mere illusion.

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Is this to say that... a flaw unseen is a flaw that does not exist, mein Fräulein?"
